ns2:course.label: Structures for the Stage I
ns2:course.description: The incorporation of structural analysis into the technical design of theatrical scenery has become a necessary tool of every Technical Director. This course is a study of the foundation vocabulary, the mathematical equations and the graphical representations that are used to assist us in solving these design challenges. Knowledge of these foundation ideas will help students to make more informed and structurally sound technical designs. 3 undergraduate hours. 3 graduate hours. Prerequisite: THEA 126. Enrollment limited to Theatre majors or by consent of instructor.
